backend.description: native adapter id; defaults to disasm.defaultBackend

file.description: open only: binary or existing IDA, Ghidra, or Binary Ninja database

output_db.description: open only: persistent backend database path for a raw binary

program.description: open only: domain path inside an existing Ghidra project

python.description: open only: one-call Python executable override for IDA or Binary Ninja

ida_dir.description: open only: one-call IDA installation directory override

java_home.description: open only: one-call Java home override for Ghidra

ghidra_dir.description: open only: one-call Ghidra installation directory override

binaryninja_dir.description: open only: one-call Binary Ninja installation directory override

sql.description: shared SQL analysis interface; writable relations use same-table INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE

code.description: backend-native code (IDAPython, Ghidra Java, or Binary Ninja Python)

stateful.description: persist the backend execution namespace between calls

takeover.description: reset only: replace a foreign stateful owner; user-directed only

release.description: reset only: clear stateful ownership after reset
